tools.name: assign_home_photos_to_room
tools.title: Assign home photos to room
tools.description: Assign existing home photos to one room group, to Additional photos, or to a newly created room. First call get_product: photo IDs are product.image.asset_id and product.gallery[].asset_id; current room membership is product.stay.photo_rooms. Supply exactly one destination: room_id with an existing ID, explicit room_id:null for Additional photos, or new_room_type. Omitting room_id does not mean null. Each selected photo needs its current expected_room_id; changed membership or a removed photo refuses the whole assignment, including new room creation. Returns the destination ID, new room ID if created and moved photo IDs. Changes only KrabiClaw; it does not update Airbnb. Edit Airbnb’s photo tour separately in Airbnb.

new_room_type.description: Create this room type and assign the photos to it. Omit room_id when using this destination.

organization_id.description: Internal organization ID from get_workspace_context or list_organizations. If omitted, uses the accessible organization saved by set_workspace_context, or the only accessible organization when no saved selection applies. Otherwise the call fails and requires a selection. Read get_workspace_context before relying on the default. A URL, domain, slug or business name is not an ID.

expected_room_id.description: Containing room’s id from get_product → product.stay.photo_rooms; null if no room contains this photo. A changed membership refuses the whole assignment.

photo_id.description: Image or video asset ID already placed on this home: get_product → product.image.asset_id or product.gallery[].asset_id.

product_id.description: The place to stay: a product of kind stay, from list_products.

room_id.description: Existing room ID from get_product → product.stay.photo_rooms, or explicit null for Additional photos. Omit only when supplying new_room_type.

outputSchema.description: Success fields for this operation. A failure returns MCP isError: true with text content explaining the reason; execution errors may include status, code and recovery fields. Failed results do not use this success schema.

created_room_id.description: The newly created room’s ID when new_room_type was supplied; otherwise null.

destination_room_id.description: The saved destination room; null means Additional photos.

moved_photo_ids.description: The selected photo IDs whose assignment was saved.

tools.name: attach_media
tools.title: Attach media
tools.description: Attach one existing media asset to an ordered collection placement (a gallery or a compliance document list), appending it after the current last item. An existing attachment stays in place; a full collection rejects a new attachment. For a single-valued placement (a cover, hero, or logo) use set_media instead. Product galleries are saved in KrabiClaw; a connected listing’s Airbnb photo tour is edited in Airbnb.

asset_id.description: The single media asset id to attach.

organization_id.description: Internal organization ID from get_workspace_context or list_organizations. If omitted, uses the accessible organization saved by set_workspace_context, or the only accessible organization when no saved selection applies. Otherwise the call fails and requires a selection. Read get_workspace_context before relying on the default. A URL, domain, slug or business name is not an ID.

outputSchema.description: Success fields for this operation. A failure returns MCP isError: true with text content explaining the reason; execution errors may include status, code and recovery fields. Failed results do not use this success schema.

context.description: The business this call acted on, its public website origin, and the location the call named, or null location fields when it named none.

tools.title: Batch create products
tools.description: Create several products in the selected site’s catalog when the user supplies a new catalog batch. Validates every entry before writing; any invalid entry rejects the complete request. Publication and location offerings are assigned separately.

active.description: Enable or disable this product. Increasing the number of live homes requires the dashboard.

details.description: Named customer-facing facts for the product kind. This is a complete replacement map; preserve fields to retain. pricing_note contains explicitly stated price wording and requires empty numeric prices.

allergens.description: Allergens the merchant states this dish contains.

cancellation_policy.description: The merchant’s stated cancellation terms, displayed publicly; this text does not automate refunds.

carbon_monoxide_detector_details.description: Share where each carbon monoxide alarm is located.

climbing_structures.description: Play or climbing structures are available to guests.

climbing_structures_details.description: Host-authored details about climbing or play structures. Requires its disclosure to be Yes.

commercial_photography_allowed.description: Whether guests may take commercial photos or film at the property.

dangerous_animals.description: Animals that could cause harm live on or near the property.

dangerous_animals_details.description: Host-authored details about potentially dangerous animals. Requires its disclosure to be Yes.

dietary_notes.description: Merchant-stated dietary facts displayed with a dish.

events_allowed.description: Whether guests may host events at the property.

exterior_security_cameras.description: Describe exterior cameras, what they monitor and whether they record audio or video.

exterior_security_cameras_details.description: Host-authored details about exterior security cameras. Requires its disclosure to be Yes.

featured.description: Highlight this item on the menu and homepage.

getting_around.description: Host-authored transport and getting-around information for this home.

guest_access.description: The spaces and facilities guests can use during their stay.

house_rules.description: The host’s rules for guests staying in the home, shown with the listing.

included_items.description: Items or work included in the stated price, shown in their own public section.

ingredients.description: Ingredients shown in the dish details.

interaction_with_guests.description: How guests can contact the host and what support is available.

limited_essentials.description: Tell guests which everyday essentials are unavailable.

limited_essentials_details.description: Host-authored details about limited essential amenities. Requires its disclosure to be Yes.

meeting_point.description: Instructions shown in the meeting section; meeting mode and video links are set in scheduling.

nearby_water.description: Guests can reach a body of water on or next to the property.

nearby_water_details.description: Host-authored details about nearby water. Requires its disclosure to be Yes.

neighborhood_description.description: Host-authored information about the neighborhood around this home.

no_property_parking.description: Dedicated guest parking is not available on the property.

no_property_parking_details.description: Host-authored details about no parking on the property. Requires its disclosure to be Yes.

noise_decibel_monitors.description: Devices measure sound levels without recording conversations.

noise_decibel_monitors_details.description: Host-authored details about noise decibel monitors. Requires its disclosure to be Yes.

noodle.description: Authored noodle information shown as dish facts; these do not establish purchasable variants.

other_details_to_note.description: Additional information guests should know before booking.

pets_allowed.description: Let guests know if they can bring pets.

potential_noise.description: Guests may hear traffic, construction or other noise.

potential_noise_details.description: Host-authored details about potential noise during stays. Requires its disclosure to be Yes.

preparation.description: Preparation instructions shown to customers before a session or appointment.

pricing_note.description: An explicitly stated price such as Market price; use only when no numeric price is set.

quiet_hours.description: Hours when guests should keep noise to a minimum.

quiet_hours_end.description: Local end of quiet hours, required with quiet hours and its start time.

quiet_hours_start.description: Local start of quiet hours, required with quiet hours and its end time.

resident_pets.description: Guests may encounter animals that live here.

resident_pets_details.description: Host-authored details about pets live on the property. Requires its disclosure to be Yes.

shared_spaces.description: Guests share some spaces with other people.

shared_spaces_details.description: Host-authored details about shared spaces. Requires its disclosure to be Yes.

sizes.description: Authored serving information; priced choices belong in variants.

smoke_detector_details.description: Share where each smoke alarm is located.

smoking_allowed.description: Whether guests may smoke or vape at the property.

soup.description: Authored soup information shown with the dish.

special_safety_considerations.description: Other property features that guests should know could be unsafe, and why.

stairs_required.description: Guests need to use stairs during their stay.

stairs_required_details.description: Host-authored details about guests must climb stairs. Requires its disclosure to be Yes.

tagline.description: A short sentence shown below the product title.

toppings.description: Authored topping information; priced choices belong in variants.

unprotected_heights.description: Elevated areas are accessible without a railing or other protection.

unprotected_heights_details.description: Host-authored details about unprotected heights. Requires its disclosure to be Yes.

unsecured_pool.description: Guests can reach a pool or hot tub without a gate or lock.

unsecured_pool_details.description: Host-authored details about unsecured pool or hot tub. Requires its disclosure to be Yes.

weapons_on_property.description: Tell guests about weapons stored on the property.

weapons_on_property_details.description: Host-authored details about weapons on the property. Requires its disclosure to be Yes.

what_to_bring.description: Items customers should bring, shown in the preparation section.

your_property.description: The spaces and features guests should know about this home.

kind.description: The customer-facing kind: dish (food or drink), experience (experience or class), service (practice area or consultation), or stay (place to stay). Determines the allowed descriptive fields; booking and stock remain separate capabilities.

marketing_features.description: Generic selling bullets. Inclusions, preparation instructions and policies are separate details.

metadata.description: Opaque string annotations for integrations. No pricing, scheduling, stock or filtering behavior may read these.

items.description: A customer choice such as Size, with values such as Small and Large. Variants combine these choices and carry prices. Descriptive facts belong in details.

order_url.description: External ordering or booking destination, such as Uber Eats, an experience checkout, or Clio Grow. When set, public actions use this URL instead of native booking. Null restores the configured native flow.

stay.description: Required for kind stay and refused for every other kind: the location the home is at (fixed once created) and its stay settings. Guest-facing house rules go in details.house_rules. Base nightly rate is the variant price.

amenities.description: Amenity codes the home offers; replaces the whole positive list. Empty offers none.

amenity_answers.description: Sparse amenity answer patch: true offers it, false explicitly reports absence, null clears to unknown. Omitted codes remain. Positive-list edits preserve false reports and remove omitted positive reports to unknown. Contradictions between amenities and amenity_answers are refused.

assigned_member_id.description: Host membership ID from list_organization_members → members[].id or get_member_scheduling → members[].id, not userId. This assignment grants the member access to the home’s stays and shows their approved public profile to guests. Publication requires an approved profile with a nonblank public_name; read get_member_public_profile. Clear assigned_team_id when choosing a member.

assigned_team_id.description: Host team ID from list_teams. This assignment grants the team access to the home’s stays and shows its members with approved public profiles to guests. At least one approved profile is required for publication. Clear assigned_member_id when choosing a team.

bathrooms.description: Whole and half baths, such as 1.5.

calendar_rules.description: Actual optional listing rules. Null removes them. Dated overrides take precedence over weekday minimums, then the required default. Friday/Saturday use the weekend price when supplied.

day_of_week_min_nights.description: Monday-first minimum nights. -1 means this weekday inherits the listing default.

weekend_price_minor.description: Whole minor units of the organization currency, e.g. cents.

cancellation_policy.description: Policy shown to guests for stays under 28 nights. A home always has one: a new home starts on Flexible, as a new Airbnb listing does, and an Airbnb import takes the listing’s own. It does not refund by itself.

check_in_end_time.description: Local 24-hour end of the check-in window; null is a flexible end. A time earlier than check_in_time is after midnight.

check_in_time.description: Local 24-hour time guests may arrive from, in the location’s timezone.

listing_floor.description: The listing’s floor, counted from 1. Cannot exceed total_floors when both are known; null when not said.

listing_type.description: Whether guests book the entire place, a private room or a shared room. Null when not said.

long_term_cancellation_policy.description: Policy shown to guests for stays of 28 nights or more. A home always has one: a new home starts on Firm Long Term, as a new Airbnb listing does, and an Airbnb import takes the listing’s own.

min_nights.description: The listing’s required default minimum; individual arrival dates may override it.

property_size.description: Property area in property_size_unit. Size and unit must both be set or both null.

property_size_unit.description: The unit of property_size. Size and unit must both be set or both null.

property_type.description: Airbnb property type, one the property_type_group offers. Null with property_type_group when not said.

property_type_group.description: Airbnb's property group: apartments (Apartment: apartment, condominium, serviced_apartment, loft); houses (House: house, townhouse, bungalow, cabin, chalet, earthhouse, hut, lighthouse, villa, dome, cottage, farmstay, houseboat, tiny_house); secondary_units (Secondary unit: guesthouse, private_suite, farmstay); unique_homes (Unique space: boat, castle, cave, earthhouse, hut, igloo, island, lighthouse, plane, rv, tent, tipi, train, treehouse, yurt, other, dome, barn, campsite, farmstay, houseboat, tiny_house, windmill, bus, holiday_park, ranch, religious_building, riad, shipping_container, tower); bnb (Bed and breakfast: bnb, nature_eco_lodge, farmstay); boutique_hotels_and_more (Boutique hotel: boutique_hotel, nature_eco_lodge, hostel, serviced_apartment, aparthotel, hotel, resort). Supply property_type with it; both are set or both null.

total_floors.description: Total floors in the property; null when not said.

year_built.description: Year the property was built; null when not said.

unit_label.description: A unit noun such as "person" or "night". Never pricing prose.

variants.description: Omit to create a single default variant. Required once the product has options.

items.description: One priced choice, such as Six pieces or Twelve pieces. Named choices may stand alone or select declared option values. Omitting variants on creation creates one default choice. Keep the id when editing to preserve its bookings.

option_values.description: Option id to option value id. Every option must be answered exactly once, and no two variants may answer identically.

items.description: A monetary offer on this variant. unit_amount is an integer in the currency smallest unit; 0 is an explicit free offer, and a variant with no price is not purchasable rather than free. Billing recurrence describes when the customer is charged, never when a class runs.

id.description: The id of a price this variant already has. Restating it keeps the price row, which payments and checkout holds reference; a price without an id is a new offer.

location_id.description: Scope this offer to one location, or null for every location the product is offered at.

outputSchema.description: Success fields for this operation. A failure returns MCP isError: true with text content explaining the reason; execution errors may include status, code and recovery fields. Failed results do not use this success schema.

active.description: The merchant sale switch. Not visibility and not stock: a disabled product is not sold out.

admin_edit_url.description: The dashboard editor for this product, on the platform host.

assigned_member_id.description: Better Auth organization membership ID of the assigned host; null when no individual host is selected.

assigned_team_id.description: Better Auth team ID of the assigned host team; null when no team is selected.

confirmation_mode.description: instant confirms immediately (default); review waits for staff approval.

held_online.description: True holds the offering online: its times are its provider's working hours, in the provider's timezone. Requires scheduling_mode provider with an assigned member or team.

online_payment_required.description: True requires online payment when booking; false is the default and does not collect online.

scheduling_mode.description: Legal consultations require provider scheduling with an explicitly assigned attorney or legal team. Experiences may use legacy business scheduling without one named provider. Physical provider times also respect the selected member’s availability; online times come from their working hours.

allergens.description: Allergens the merchant states this dish contains.

cancellation_policy.description: The merchant’s stated cancellation terms, displayed publicly; this text does not automate refunds.

carbon_monoxide_detector_details.description: Share where each carbon monoxide alarm is located.

climbing_structures.description: Play or climbing structures are available to guests.

climbing_structures_details.description: Host-authored details about climbing or play structures. Requires its disclosure to be Yes.

commercial_photography_allowed.description: Whether guests may take commercial photos or film at the property.

dangerous_animals.description: Animals that could cause harm live on or near the property.

dangerous_animals_details.description: Host-authored details about potentially dangerous animals. Requires its disclosure to be Yes.

dietary_notes.description: Merchant-stated dietary facts displayed with a dish.

events_allowed.description: Whether guests may host events at the property.

exterior_security_cameras.description: Describe exterior cameras, what they monitor and whether they record audio or video.

exterior_security_cameras_details.description: Host-authored details about exterior security cameras. Requires its disclosure to be Yes.

featured.description: Highlight this item on the menu and homepage.

getting_around.description: Host-authored transport and getting-around information for this home.

guest_access.description: The spaces and facilities guests can use during their stay.

house_rules.description: The host’s rules for guests staying in the home, shown with the listing.

included_items.description: Items or work included in the stated price, shown in their own public section.

ingredients.description: Ingredients shown in the dish details.

interaction_with_guests.description: How guests can contact the host and what support is available.

limited_essentials.description: Tell guests which everyday essentials are unavailable.

limited_essentials_details.description: Host-authored details about limited essential amenities. Requires its disclosure to be Yes.

meeting_point.description: Instructions shown in the meeting section; meeting mode and video links are set in scheduling.

nearby_water.description: Guests can reach a body of water on or next to the property.

nearby_water_details.description: Host-authored details about nearby water. Requires its disclosure to be Yes.

neighborhood_description.description: Host-authored information about the neighborhood around this home.

no_property_parking.description: Dedicated guest parking is not available on the property.

noise_decibel_monitors.description: Devices measure sound levels without recording conversations.

noise_decibel_monitors_details.description: Host-authored details about noise decibel monitors. Requires its disclosure to be Yes.

noodle.description: Authored noodle information shown as dish facts; these do not establish purchasable variants.

other_details_to_note.description: Additional information guests should know before booking.

pets_allowed.description: Let guests know if they can bring pets.

potential_noise.description: Guests may hear traffic, construction or other noise.

potential_noise_details.description: Host-authored details about potential noise during stays. Requires its disclosure to be Yes.

preparation.description: Preparation instructions shown to customers before a session or appointment.

pricing_note.description: An explicitly stated price such as Market price; use only when no numeric price is set.

quiet_hours.description: Hours when guests should keep noise to a minimum.

quiet_hours_end.description: Local end of quiet hours, required with quiet hours and its start time.

quiet_hours_start.description: Local start of quiet hours, required with quiet hours and its end time.

resident_pets.description: Guests may encounter animals that live here.

resident_pets_details.description: Host-authored details about pets live on the property. Requires its disclosure to be Yes.

shared_spaces.description: Guests share some spaces with other people.

shared_spaces_details.description: Host-authored details about shared spaces. Requires its disclosure to be Yes.

sizes.description: Authored serving information; priced choices belong in variants.

smoke_detector_details.description: Share where each smoke alarm is located.

smoking_allowed.description: Whether guests may smoke or vape at the property.

soup.description: Authored soup information shown with the dish.

special_safety_considerations.description: Other property features that guests should know could be unsafe, and why.

stairs_required.description: Guests need to use stairs during their stay.

stairs_required_details.description: Host-authored details about guests must climb stairs. Requires its disclosure to be Yes.

tagline.description: A short sentence shown below the product title.

toppings.description: Authored topping information; priced choices belong in variants.

unprotected_heights.description: Elevated areas are accessible without a railing or other protection.

unprotected_heights_details.description: Host-authored details about unprotected heights. Requires its disclosure to be Yes.

unsecured_pool.description: Guests can reach a pool or hot tub without a gate or lock.

unsecured_pool_details.description: Host-authored details about unsecured pool or hot tub. Requires its disclosure to be Yes.

weapons_on_property.description: Tell guests about weapons stored on the property.

weapons_on_property_details.description: Host-authored details about weapons on the property. Requires its disclosure to be Yes.

what_to_bring.description: Items customers should bring, shown in the preparation section.

your_property.description: The spaces and features guests should know about this home.

page.description: The source page this product owns, or null. Edit its content with the site-page tools; its binding is the page's product_id.

stay.description: Non-null exactly for a place to stay: its one location and stay settings (arrival, departure, guests, minimum nights, who looks after it, what it is and offers, its cancellation policies). accessibility.description: All six home accessibility features in catalog order, including unanswered null rows.

available.description: The host’s answer; null is unanswered. No review or approval is implied.

photo_ids.description: Evidence image IDs in the home’s Product photo order. Empty for false or unknown answers.

amenities.description: Amenity codes the home offers. Empty means no positive amenity answers.

amenity_answers.description: Explicit amenity reports, each code once, in catalog order. Missing codes are unknown. amenities is the true-only projection.

assigned_member_id.description: Better Auth organization membership ID of the home’s assigned host; null when no individual host is selected.

assigned_team_id.description: Better Auth team ID assigned to host and look after the home; null when no team is selected.

bathrooms.description: Whole and half baths, such as 1.5.

calendar_rules.description: Actual optional listing rules. Null removes them. Dated overrides take precedence over weekday minimums, then the required default. Friday/Saturday use the weekend price when supplied.

day_of_week_min_nights.description: Monday-first minimum nights. -1 means this weekday inherits the listing default.

weekend_price_minor.description: Whole minor units of the organization currency, e.g. cents.

cancellation_policy.description: Policy shown to guests for stays under 28 nights. A home always has one: a new home starts on Flexible, as a new Airbnb listing does, and an Airbnb import takes the listing’s own. It does not refund by itself.

check_in_end_time.description: Local 24-hour end of the check-in window; null is a flexible end. A time earlier than check_in_time is after midnight.

check_in_time.description: Local 24-hour time guests may arrive from, in the location’s timezone.

listing_floor.description: The listing’s floor, counted from 1. Cannot exceed total_floors when both are known; null when not said.

listing_type.description: Whether guests book the entire place, a private room or a shared room. Null when not said.

long_term_cancellation_policy.description: Policy shown to guests for stays of 28 nights or more. A home always has one: a new home starts on Firm Long Term, as a new Airbnb listing does, and an Airbnb import takes the listing’s own.

min_nights.description: The listing’s required default minimum; individual arrival dates may override it.

accessibility.description: Both bedroom features in catalog order, including unanswered null rows; [] for other room types.

available.description: The host’s answer; null is unanswered. No review or approval is implied.

photo_ids.description: Evidence image IDs in the home’s Product photo order. Empty for false or unknown answers.

amenities.description: Amenities assigned to this room, each once.

private_attached_bathroom.description: Whether this bedroom has a private attached bathroom. Null is unanswered. Only bedrooms may author this fact.

sleeping_arrangements.description: This room’s allocated beds. Null is unanswered; [] explicitly states none.

property_size.description: Property area in property_size_unit. Size and unit must both be set or both null.

property_size_unit.description: The unit of property_size. Size and unit must both be set or both null.

property_type.description: Airbnb property type, one the property_type_group offers. Null with property_type_group when not said.

property_type_group.description: Airbnb's property group: apartments (Apartment: apartment, condominium, serviced_apartment, loft); houses (House: house, townhouse, bungalow, cabin, chalet, earthhouse, hut, lighthouse, villa, dome, cottage, farmstay, houseboat, tiny_house); secondary_units (Secondary unit: guesthouse, private_suite, farmstay); unique_homes (Unique space: boat, castle, cave, earthhouse, hut, igloo, island, lighthouse, plane, rv, tent, tipi, train, treehouse, yurt, other, dome, barn, campsite, farmstay, houseboat, tiny_house, windmill, bus, holiday_park, ranch, religious_building, riad, shipping_container, tower); bnb (Bed and breakfast: bnb, nature_eco_lodge, farmstay); boutique_hotels_and_more (Boutique hotel: boutique_hotel, nature_eco_lodge, hostel, serviced_apartment, aparthotel, hotel, resort).

total_floors.description: Total floors in the property; null when not said.

year_built.description: Year the property was built; null when not said.

location_id.description: The location this offer applies at, or null for a location-neutral offer. Null is a declared scope, not a missing value.

unit_amount.description: Integer amount in the currency smallest unit.

tools.name: create_product
tools.title: Create product
tools.description: Add food or drink, an experience or class, a practice area or consultation, or a place to stay. An experience can start as a private draft without booking setup. To make it public, configure its booking flow or supply an external booking URL. Supplying booking creates its configuration, offering, schedule and public page together, using instant confirmation and no online collection by default. A place to stay needs stay (its location and stay settings), keeps its public house rules in details, and is priced per night by its variant price; guests book it on the site and pay in full, so it takes no order_url and publishes only once it has a nightly price and online payments are set up. Repeat the same idempotency key on retry.

items.description: Household size, 250% income limit, 350% income limit, 400% income limit, in that order.

active.description: Enable or disable this product. Increasing the number of live homes requires the dashboard.

booking.description: Complete booking setup for a published offering. Legal consultations require provider scheduling and an explicitly selected attorney or legal team. At a location, provide weekly_slots or dated sessions; an update can retain its saved weekly times. location_id null holds it online: it needs scheduling_mode provider with an assigned member or team, takes no weekly_slots or sessions, and is booked in that provider's working hours. Runtime validation requires actual future availability before publication.

check_in_end_time.description: Local 24-hour end of the check-in window; null is a flexible end. A time earlier than check_in_time is after midnight.

check_in_time.description: Local 24-hour time guests may arrive from, in the location’s timezone.

min_nights.description: The listing’s required default minimum; individual arrival dates may override it.

location_id.description: Scope this offer to one location, or null for every location the product is offered at.

calendar_rules.description: Actual optional listing rules. Null removes them. Dated overrides take precedence over weekday minimums, then the required default. Friday/Saturday use the weekend price when supplied.

day_of_week_min_nights.description: Monday-first minimum nights. -1 means this weekday inherits the listing default.

weekend_price_minor.description: Whole minor units of the organization currency, e.g. cents.

cancellation_policy.description: Policy shown to guests for stays under 28 nights. A home always has one: a new home starts on Flexible, as a new Airbnb listing does, and an Airbnb import takes the listing’s own. It does not refund by itself.

check_in_end_time.description: Local 24-hour end of the check-in window; null is a flexible end. A time earlier than check_in_time is after midnight.

check_in_time.description: Local 24-hour time guests may arrive from, in the location’s timezone.

listing_floor.description: The listing’s floor, counted from 1. Cannot exceed total_floors when both are known; null when not said.

listing_type.description: Whether guests book the entire place, a private room or a shared room. Null when not said.

long_term_cancellation_policy.description: Policy shown to guests for stays of 28 nights or more. A home always has one: a new home starts on Firm Long Term, as a new Airbnb listing does, and an Airbnb import takes the listing’s own.

min_nights.description: The listing’s required default minimum; individual arrival dates may override it.

accessibility.description: Both bedroom features in catalog order, including unanswered null rows; [] for other room types.

available.description: The host’s answer; null is unanswered. No review or approval is implied.

photo_ids.description: Evidence image IDs in the home’s Product photo order. Empty for false or unknown answers.

amenities.description: Amenities assigned to this room, each once.

private_attached_bathroom.description: Whether this bedroom has a private attached bathroom. Null is unanswered. Only bedrooms may author this fact.

sleeping_arrangements.description: This room’s allocated beds. Null is unanswered; [] explicitly states none.

property_size.description: Property area in property_size_unit. Size and unit must both be set or both null.

property_size_unit.description: The unit of property_size. Size and unit must both be set or both null.

property_type.description: Airbnb property type, one the property_type_group offers. Null with property_type_group when not said.

property_type_group.description: Airbnb's property group: apartments (Apartment: apartment, condominium, serviced_apartment, loft); houses (House: house, townhouse, bungalow, cabin, chalet, earthhouse, hut, lighthouse, villa, dome, cottage, farmstay, houseboat, tiny_house); secondary_units (Secondary unit: guesthouse, private_suite, farmstay); unique_homes (Unique space: boat, castle, cave, earthhouse, hut, igloo, island, lighthouse, plane, rv, tent, tipi, train, treehouse, yurt, other, dome, barn, campsite, farmstay, houseboat, tiny_house, windmill, bus, holiday_park, ranch, religious_building, riad, shipping_container, tower); bnb (Bed and breakfast: bnb, nature_eco_lodge, farmstay); boutique_hotels_and_more (Boutique hotel: boutique_hotel, nature_eco_lodge, hostel, serviced_apartment, aparthotel, hotel, resort).

total_floors.description: Total floors in the property; null when not said.

year_built.description: Year the property was built; null when not said.

location_id.description: The location this offer applies at, or null for a location-neutral offer. Null is a declared scope, not a missing value.

unit_amount.description: Integer amount in the currency smallest unit.

accessibility.description: All six home accessibility features in catalog order, including unanswered null rows.

available.description: The host’s answer; null is unanswered. No review or approval is implied.

photo_ids.description: Evidence image IDs in the home’s Product photo order. Empty for false or unknown answers.

amenities.description: Amenity codes the home offers. Empty means no positive amenity answers.

amenity_answers.description: Explicit amenity reports, each code once, in catalog order. Missing codes are unknown. amenities is the true-only projection.

assigned_member_id.description: Better Auth organization membership ID of the home’s assigned host; null when no individual host is selected.

assigned_team_id.description: Better Auth team ID assigned to host and look after the home; null when no team is selected.

bathrooms.description: Whole and half baths, such as 1.5.

calendar_rules.description: Actual optional listing rules. Null removes them. Dated overrides take precedence over weekday minimums, then the required default. Friday/Saturday use the weekend price when supplied.

day_of_week_min_nights.description: Monday-first minimum nights. -1 means this weekday inherits the listing default.

weekend_price_minor.description: Whole minor units of the organization currency, e.g. cents.

cancellation_policy.description: Policy shown to guests for stays under 28 nights. A home always has one: a new home starts on Flexible, as a new Airbnb listing does, and an Airbnb import takes the listing’s own. It does not refund by itself.

check_in_end_time.description: Local 24-hour end of the check-in window; null is a flexible end. A time earlier than check_in_time is after midnight.

check_in_time.description: Local 24-hour time guests may arrive from, in the location’s timezone.

listing_floor.description: The listing’s floor, counted from 1. Cannot exceed total_floors when both are known; null when not said.

listing_type.description: Whether guests book the entire place, a private room or a shared room. Null when not said.

long_term_cancellation_policy.description: Policy shown to guests for stays of 28 nights or more. A home always has one: a new home starts on Firm Long Term, as a new Airbnb listing does, and an Airbnb import takes the listing’s own.

min_nights.description: The listing’s required default minimum; individual arrival dates may override it.

accessibility.description: Both bedroom features in catalog order, including unanswered null rows; [] for other room types.

available.description: The host’s answer; null is unanswered. No review or approval is implied.

photo_ids.description: Evidence image IDs in the home’s Product photo order. Empty for false or unknown answers.

amenities.description: Amenities assigned to this room, each once.

private_attached_bathroom.description: Whether this bedroom has a private attached bathroom. Null is unanswered. Only bedrooms may author this fact.

sleeping_arrangements.description: This room’s allocated beds. Null is unanswered; [] explicitly states none.

property_size.description: Property area in property_size_unit. Size and unit must both be set or both null.

property_size_unit.description: The unit of property_size. Size and unit must both be set or both null.

property_type.description: Airbnb property type, one the property_type_group offers. Null with property_type_group when not said.

property_type_group.description: Airbnb's property group: apartments (Apartment: apartment, condominium, serviced_apartment, loft); houses (House: house, townhouse, bungalow, cabin, chalet, earthhouse, hut, lighthouse, villa, dome, cottage, farmstay, houseboat, tiny_house); secondary_units (Secondary unit: guesthouse, private_suite, farmstay); unique_homes (Unique space: boat, castle, cave, earthhouse, hut, igloo, island, lighthouse, plane, rv, tent, tipi, train, treehouse, yurt, other, dome, barn, campsite, farmstay, houseboat, tiny_house, windmill, bus, holiday_park, ranch, religious_building, riad, shipping_container, tower); bnb (Bed and breakfast: bnb, nature_eco_lodge, farmstay); boutique_hotels_and_more (Boutique hotel: boutique_hotel, nature_eco_lodge, hostel, serviced_apartment, aparthotel, hotel, resort).

total_floors.description: Total floors in the property; null when not said.

year_built.description: Year the property was built; null when not said.

location_id.description: The location this offer applies at, or null for a location-neutral offer. Null is a declared scope, not a missing value.

unit_amount.description: Integer amount in the currency smallest unit.

tools.name: reconcile_products
tools.title: Reconcile products
tools.description: Synchronize complete catalog entries in one atomic local write. Existing product IDs preserve identity; supplied variants, prices and options replace their lists. Omitted products stay unchanged unless deactivate_missing disables them. A new home requires stay settings. Changed connected-home settings and nightly prices are pushed to Airbnb through Channex after saving. Unsupported connected-listing settings are refused before any local writes; a failed channel completion reports committed changes with CHANNEL_PUSH_FAILED. Repeat the same idempotency key for an identical retry. Use update_menu for a restaurant menu and update_product for a partial edit. Increasing the number of live homes requires the dashboard.

tools.name: update_product
tools.title: Update product
tools.description: Edit a product and return its updated record. For a price change, supply the variant ID, price ID and unit_amount. Variants and prices merge by ID; omitted entries stay. Supplied options and details replace their current values by default. Use details_mode merge for focused fact edits, preserving unmentioned facts and clearing named facts with null. Booking setup also creates sessions and publishes the offering. For a connected Airbnb home, changed arrival/departure windows, cancellation, pet/smoking/event rules and minimum stays update supported listing settings through Channex. Unsupported connected-listing settings are refused before saving. A failed channel completion reports the committed edit with CHANNEL_PUSH_FAILED; reload before retrying. Increasing the number of live homes requires the dashboard.

active.description: Enable or disable this product. Increasing the number of live homes requires the dashboard.

booking.description: Complete booking setup for a published offering. Legal consultations require provider scheduling and an explicitly selected attorney or legal team. At a location, provide weekly_slots or dated sessions; an update can retain its saved weekly times. location_id null holds it online: it needs scheduling_mode provider with an assigned member or team, takes no weekly_slots or sessions, and is booked in that provider's working hours. Runtime validation requires actual future availability before publication.

assigned_member_id.description: Host membership ID from list_organization_members → members[].id or get_member_scheduling → members[].id, not userId. Guests see this member’s approved public profile. Read get_member_public_profile; publication requires an approved profile with a nonblank public_name. Clear assigned_team_id when choosing a member.

assigned_team_id.description: Host team ID from list_teams. Guests see the team’s members with approved public profiles; at least one is required for publication. Clear assigned_member_id when choosing a team.

confirmation_mode.description: instant confirms immediately (default); review waits for staff approval.

scheduling_mode.description: Legal consultations require provider scheduling with an explicitly assigned attorney or legal team. Experiences may use legacy business scheduling without one named provider. Physical provider times also respect the selected member’s availability; online times come from their working hours.

start_time.description: Local HH:mm start time; visit duration is configured separately.

amenities.description: Amenity codes the home offers; replaces the whole positive list. Empty offers none.

items.description: A partial update to an existing variant by id, or a new variant. Existing variants retain omitted fields and option selections. New variants require a name and complete option selections.

option_values.description: Option id to option value id. Every option must be answered exactly once, and no two variants may answer identically.

prices.description: Partial existing prices by id or new offers. Omitted prices remain unless prices_mode is replace. A new offer requires unit_amount.

items.description: A monetary offer on this variant. unit_amount is an integer in the currency smallest unit; 0 is an explicit free offer, and a variant with no price is not purchasable rather than free. Billing recurrence describes when the customer is charged, never when a class runs.

id.description: The id of a price this variant already has. Restating it keeps the price row, which payments and checkout holds reference; a price without an id is a new offer.

location_id.description: Scope this offer to one location, or null for every location the product is offered at.

prices_mode.description: merge keeps prices omitted from the supplied list. replace explicitly removes omitted prices; an empty list clears them. Applies only with prices.

variants_mode.description: merge preserves variants omitted from the supplied list. replace explicitly removes omitted variants and their owned records; removal is refused once a variant has booking history. Applies only with variants.

prompts.name: set_up_products
prompts.description: Build out Products from a free-text description of names, collections, and prices.

arguments.name: items_description
arguments.description: Free text describing the Products, collections, and prices to add.

rendered.description: Build out Products from a description
rendered.text: Update the catalog from: <items_description> Use get_workspace_context, list_organizations and list_locations to resolve the business and explicit location. Read every relevant list_location_products and list_collections page before matching existing IDs. For a restaurant menu, use update_menu with a stable idempotency_key, the stated sections and prices. Match existing product, variant, price and collection IDs. Omitted items and order remain; use set_collection_products or reorder_collections only when the user requests a complete new order. For other products, use create_product for new entries or update_product for partial edits. Use reconcile_products only when the user requests complete replacement of the supplied entries. Ask for missing prices or booking facts. Use get_product and list_location_products to read back the result, then open the returned public URL before reporting completion.

prompts.name: create_and_publish_post
prompts.description: Create a short post, review its draft, and publish it to the destinations the user names.

arguments.name: body
arguments.description: The caption, as the user wants it read. Event dates, offers and codes are part of it.

arguments.name: destinations
arguments.description: Where to publish, in the user's words: website, Facebook, Instagram, Discord, or several. Nothing is assumed.

rendered.text: Call create_post with a new idempotency_key and this body: <body> If the user supplied or approved media, pass it as create_post media in the order they want it shown: the cover first, then the gallery. Publish only to: <destinations>. For Facebook, Instagram or Discord, call get_social_connections and use the exact target_id and connection_revision it returns; if the destination is not connected or has a problem, say so instead of publishing elsewhere. Show the user the draft's preview_url, then call publish_post with the post's updated_at as expected_updated_at and one target per named destination. Report each outcome exactly as returned. processing means call publish_post again later to finish the same post; unknown means use reconcile_post_publication, never publish again.

prompts.name: set_up_bookable_product
prompts.description: Create a new bookable Product from a description.

arguments.name: description
arguments.description: What it is, including price/duration/capacity if known.

rendered.text: Create a bookable offering from: <description> Use get_workspace_context, list_locations and list_products to resolve the business, existing offerings and explicit location or online scope. Ask for missing price, duration, capacity, actual start times, confirmation and payment choices. Use create_product with booking setup and one idempotency key. Preserve the supplied facts and attach supplied media to the returned product ID. Use get_product to read booking_readiness and list_product_booking_sessions with a concrete date range to verify actual availability. Use save_media_attachment for supplied files or attach_media for existing assets. Open the returned public URL before reporting completion.

prompts.name: triage_inbox
prompts.description: Summarize guest and team conversations, pending bookings and reviews awaiting a reply.

rendered.description: Summarize guest and team conversations, pending bookings, and unreplied reviews
rendered.text: Use get_workspace_context to resolve the requested business. Read all relevant list_guest_conversations pages and get_guest_conversation for full contact messages, table reservation and product booking details, proposals and delivery receipts. For internal team messages use list_team_conversations and get_team_conversation. Select actual teammates with list_team_conversation_recipients. start_team_conversation reuses direct and explicit stay/location conversations; manual groups of at least three people are distinct and require a stable idempotency_key. update_team_group changes only manual internal groups: obey canManage/canLeave; preserve buyer/guest and stay/location participants. New members can read group history; removal and leaving end access while retaining messages. Use send_team_message only for the requested internal message, then read it back. Reading does not mark a thread read; mark_team_conversation_read changes only the caller’s read position. Team chat is separate from guest replies and Better Auth Team/group management. Summarize unanswered messages and pending bookings. Use reply_to_guest with a stable idempotency_key only for the message or photo the user requests. Use get_product_booking before confirm_product_booking, reject_product_booking, cancel_product_booking or request_product_booking_change; use cancel_table_reservation or request_table_reservation_change for an explicitly requested table reservation action. Booking changes email a proposal and leave the existing allocation unchanged until guest acceptance. Financial actions requiring the dashboard remain incomplete; report the returned handoff instead of claiming completion. Use list_locations and list_location_reviews to read reviews separately; provider reviews and imported Google Q&A remain managed in Google. Report failed deliveries and actions awaiting guest acceptance accurately.

prompts.name: improve_my_homepage
prompts.description: Review the homepage and suggest the highest-impact changes to make it look better and more inviting.

rendered.text: Use get_workspace_context, list_site_pages and get_site_page to read the selected business's homepage, and list_media_assets for its media. Open its public preview and recommend the most useful improvements in plain language. Check if hero media, brand logo, favicon, and bookable offerings (such as places to stay or menu items via product_grid) are present, and ask the user for any missing brand assets. Apply requested copy changes with update_site_page; use set_media for one image or attach_media, remove_media and reorder_media for a gallery. Read back the page and public result.

prompts.name: add_photos_to_organization
prompts.description: Add the user's own photos to the right places on the site (homepage, location, Products, or posts).

rendered.text: Inspect the supplied photos and use get_workspace_context plus the relevant get_site_page, get_location, get_product or get_post read to resolve the intended owner and placement. Ask only about an ambiguous destination. Use save_media_attachment with a stable idempotency_key and the intended placement for each attachment; retries reuse that key. For an existing asset use set_media or attach_media. Read back the owner and open the public result before reporting placement.

prompts.name: finish_my_organization_setup
prompts.description: Identify missing business facts and finish the requested site setup.

rendered.text: Use get_workspace_context and list_organizations to resolve the business. For an unfinished website use get_website_draft, save_website_draft and publish_website with the returned draft ID and revision. For an existing website use get_organization, list_locations, list_site_pages, get_site_page and list_products to identify the missing facts. Check for missing brand assets like logo, favicon, social card, palette colors, hero media, and about page story. Ask for those facts, use update_organization_settings, update_site_page, update_menu or create_product for the requested setup, and read back its public result.

prompts.name: make_organization_more_bookable
prompts.description: Review calls-to-action, contact info, and reservation/booking setup, and suggest changes to get more bookings.

rendered.text: Use get_workspace_context, list_products, get_product and list_product_booking_sessions to read the public offering, booking readiness and actual availability. Use list_locations, get_location and get_reservation_policy for location hours and table reservation setup. Identify what prevents guests from booking and ask for missing business facts. Use update_product with booking setup, set_product_booking_config, replace_product_weekly_schedule or update_reservation_policy for the changes the user requests. Read back readiness, available times and the public result.

prompts.name: make_my_organization_look_better
prompts.description: Review the website and recommend concrete visual and content improvements.

rendered.text: Use get_workspace_context, list_site_pages, get_site_page, list_media_assets and list_products to read the actual public pages, media and catalog. Recommend specific improvements in plain language: high-impact hero image or video, logo and favicon, brand colors, offerings showcase on the homepage, and host story with portrait on the about page. Apply the requested copy with update_site_page or update_product, and media with set_media or attach_media. Read back the changed record and verify the public result.

prompts.name: grow_my_bookings
prompts.description: Look at traffic, listing completeness, and booking/reservation demand together, and suggest the highest-impact next move to get more bookings this week.

rendered.text: Use get_workspace_context and get_organization_analytics to read recent traffic. Use list_products, get_product and list_product_booking_sessions for bookable offerings and availability, and list_guest_conversations plus get_guest_conversation for current guest demand. Recommend the most useful action supported by those records. Use reply_to_guest, update_product or create_post and publish_post for the action the user requests, then read back its actual outcome and report any incomplete delivery or dashboard handoff.
